title: MayerVietorisGlobalExtComparison
statement:
theorem H.globalFreeExtComparison (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (M : X.Modules) :
    let F := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M
    let G := invImage (baseChangeFst (S := S) f)
    let N := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (baseChangedScheme (S := S) f).ringCatSheaf).obj
      (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)
    let φ := coeff (baseChangeFst (S := S) f) (baseChangeUnit (S := S) f M)
    let ρ := (scalarRep M).comp (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom)
    let τ := (scalarRep (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)).comp
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv ≫ (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f).appTop).hom)
    ∃ (e : ∀ n, HOver f M n ≃+ Ext (H.openFreeSheaf (⊤ : X.Opens)) F n)
      (e' : ∀ n, HOver (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f) (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M) n ≃+
        Ext (G.obj (H.openFreeSheaf (⊤ : X.Opens))) N n),
      (∀ n a x, e n (a • x) = (e n x).comp (Ext.mk₀ (ρ a)) (add_zero n)) ∧
      (∀ n a x, e' n (a • x) = (e' n x).comp (Ext.mk₀ (τ a)) (add_zero n)) ∧
      (∀ n x, e' n (H.baseChangeLinear (S := S) f M n x) =
        ((e n x).mapExactFunctor G).comp (Ext.mk₀ φ) (add_zero n))

proof.text: On every represented open U, the hom-set Hom(U, top) is a singleton. FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv followed by AddEquiv.ulift.symm identifies its free abelian group with ULift integers. FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext proves naturality on generators. Sheafification of this presheaf isomorphism gives topFreeIso from the free sheaf on top to the constant integer sheaf. This construction also works on the empty scheme.

Prove the comparison generically in abelian categories: precomposition with i and with G.mapIso i followed by c gives the two additive Ext equivalences. Ext.comp_assoc gives the postcomposition identities. Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp and Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀ move precomposition through G; associativity and c.hom_inv_id cancel the constant-sheaf comparison in the base-change identity. All three identities are combined in the fully proved private theorem extComparison. Specialize it with i = topFreeIso X, c = constIso of the base-change projection, and the defined coefficient and scalar maps of def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison. HOver, its scalar action, and H.baseChangeLinear are definitionally the Ext groups, postcomposition, and mapped Ext comparison in that generic theorem. No derived open-restriction adjunction or Mayer--Vietoris short-exactness theorem is used.

proof_origin.place: Top-open special case of the free abelian sheaf presentation; direct constant-integer sheaf and Ext functoriality proof by H2, using the canonical comparison of Section 01F7.
